entries.title: A crewmate can attach a release file, and runs a program you ask for
entries.body: A crewmate can now attach a file from its work to a release through your GitHub or GitLab sign-in. When you ask a crewmate to run a program, it runs that program.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes: the change is in what a crewmate can send and which programs it will run when you ask.
